sections.heading: Do not simply accumulate wealth; design it intelligently.

paragraphs.text: Dr. Nasim Mohammadhasani | Wealth Architect and Strategic Financial Advisor
Important financial decisions are not limited to choosing an asset; understanding your wealth structure, risks and future objectives matters as well.
Drawing on financial management experience and the professional DNH framework, I help you examine the options ahead with greater precision and a longer-term perspective.

sections.trust_line: Sound decisions begin with understanding the issue, not with promises of returns.

sections.heading: Dr. Nasim Mohammadhasani: expertise dedicated to wealth architecture

paragraphs.text: Dr. Nasim Mohammadhasani is a wealth architect and strategic financial advisor with a PhD in Financial Engineering and a Master's degree in Financial Management.
More than 15 years of financial management experience and over 5 years of work in investment and asset management underpin her specialist perspective and the development of the DNH framework.

paragraphs.text: If you face an important decision concerning investment, your asset structure, risk management or the future of your business, an initial assessment can provide an appropriate starting point.
